name: perf-integration-pekko
description: Released Scala 3 (3.10.0, Maven Central) against the scala3-perf-integration branch (upstream/main + retronym's open perf PRs, built as released: bootstrapped, -opt), both published jars, compiling pekko-actor (203 Scala + 28 Java files, exported from the zinc integration campaigns) in memory.
Directional, not absolute: one fork per cell, 3 rounds, JDK 21.
pekko-actor's exported options are for 3.3 LTS; `-source:3.7` keeps `A with B` types a deprecation, not the error they are from 3.8 on.

variantDescriptions.main: scala3-perf-integration, BENCHMARKBUILD publishLocal (see PERF-INTEGRATION.md on the branch)
